description: Bus routes whose name, or first or last stop, contains a keyword, with their endpoints, operators and fare. Use it to find the exact route name the other bus tools need. Example: city "Taipei", keyword "307"; or city "InterCity", keyword "1610".

city.description: City: a TDX code (Taipei, NewTaipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, Tainan, Kaohsiung, Keelung, Hsinchu, HsinchuCounty, MiaoliCounty, ChanghuaCounty, NantouCounty, YunlinCounty, ChiayiCounty, Chiayi, PingtungCounty, YilanCounty, HualienCounty, TaitungCounty, KinmenCounty, PenghuCounty, LienchiangCounty) or its Chinese name (臺北市, 新北市, ...), or "InterCity" for 公路客運 / 國道客運 coaches between cities.

keyword.description: Route name or part of it ("307", "紅"), or a terminal stop ("動物園").

limit.description: Maximum number of routes to return (default 20).

name: bus_route_search
title: Search bus routes
